property_equivalents.note: A child's own cross-axis alignment is its parent's Align items when every child of that parent asks the same.

A declared height on an image, SVG or logo of intrinsic ratio is its maximum height when the box keeps that ratio at every width: the width follows the height, so a maximum of the rendered height paints the same box, per tier.
A declared height is the block's minimum height when the element renders at that height: its content fits, so the minimum paints the same box.
A grid child's own inline alignment is its parent's Justify items when every child of that parent asks the same.
